title: 对不起，你爱吃的虾，其实用过药 | 原文
content: Consumers are likely unaware that most shrimp they eat, particularly farmed varieties like whiteleg shrimp, have been treated with various substances. While natural marine and river shrimp are common in diets, commercial farming practices frequently utilize medications and chemical additives. This widespread use of pharmaceuticals during the aquaculture process raises food safety concerns, suggesting that the shrimp on everyday tables are often part of an industrialized system relying on intensive management techniques rather than purely natural growth.
